# Gamoventure

> Gamoventure is an independent software engineering and web development studio serving growing businesses in India and internationally. We build fixed-scope informational business websites (₹10,000 and ₹25,000), customer portals, offline-capable operational systems, and custom software products shaped around daily workflows.

Last updated: 2026-11-23
Website: https://www.gamoventure.in
Email: hello@gamoventure.in
Telephone / WhatsApp: +91 8080251000
LinkedIn: https://www.linkedin.com/company/gamoventure

## Core services and pricing

- [Business Websites & Customer Portals](https://www.gamoventure.in/services/business-websites): Fixed informational website packages at ₹10,000 (up to 5 pages, 5 business days) and ₹25,000 (up to 8 pages, 10 business days, custom layouts, Search Console and analytics setup). Portals quoted separately.
- [Machine-readable website pricing spec](https://www.gamoventure.in/pricing.md): Full package comparison table, inclusions, turnaround terms, 30-day defect window, and exclusions.
- [Custom Business Software & Automation](https://www.gamoventure.in/services/custom-business-software): Purpose-built order, billing, inventory, dashboard, and workflow automation systems, scoped and quoted after workflow discovery.
- [Digital Product Design & Development](https://www.gamoventure.in/services/product-development): End-to-end discovery, UI design, full-stack development, automated testing, and release preparation for custom software products.
- [Capabilities Overview](https://www.gamoventure.in/capabilities): Product strategy, digital experiences, business systems, product engineering, and post-launch maintenance.

## Selected client work

- [Egg Express POS Case Study](https://www.gamoventure.in/work/egg-express-pos): Local-first Windows and PostgreSQL restaurant point-of-sale, kitchen order ticket (KOT), billing, and recipe-linked inventory system for a food outlet in Ulhasnagar, Maharashtra (currently in development; core demonstrated, live outlet rollout ahead).
- [Client Work Index](https://www.gamoventure.in/work): Overview of Egg Express POS and the seven-page business website in development for Shree Maruti Transport Services (chemical and liquid cargo transporter in Bhiwandi, Maharashtra).

## Studio and policies

- [About Gamoventure](https://www.gamoventure.in/about): Independent, remote-first digital product studio where clients work directly with the founding team.
- [Contact Gamoventure](https://www.gamoventure.in/contact): Project inquiry form (two-business-day response target), direct email, telephone, and WhatsApp.
- [Privacy Policy](https://www.gamoventure.in/privacy): Inquiry handling via Vercel and Hostinger SMTP, no advertising or analytics cookies.
- [Terms of Use](https://www.gamoventure.in/terms): Website terms, inquiry disclaimers, and development-status disclosures.
